# Local frontend dependencies

Pinned React 18.3.1 production UMD builds, distributed under the MIT license. License notices are retained in the files.

Sources:
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/react/18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/react-dom/18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js

These local files remove the runtime CDN dependency. JSX in index.html was compiled using Babel standalone 7.25.6 with the React preset.
